correctness.rationale: Differentiating \(H=-z+(k+2)x^2/(2a)\) gives exactly \(b-(k+1)x^2-(y-x)^2=b-(k+1)x^2-\dot x^2/a^2\). Integrating the generator against any compact invariant probability measure yields the shell and the RMS ceiling. If equality holds, continuity and zero integral of \(\dot x^2\) force \(\dot x=0\) on the invariant support, hence y=x there. Invariance then excludes the drifting line x=y=0 from compact support and forces z=-c together with \((k+1)x^2=b\), leaving exactly the two equilibrium points; their convex combinations attain equality. The periodic-orbit strictness is the same identity integrated over a period. Exact rational arithmetic verifies the published parameter specialization.
